title: The ribonucleoprotein hnRNPA1 mediates binding to RNA and DNA telomeric G-quadruplexes through an RGG-rich region.
authors: Balasubramanian, Sangeetha; Roy, Irawati; Appadurai, Rajeswari; Srivastava, Anand
one_liner_zh: 该文用增强采样模拟研究hnRNPA1的RGG结构域与端粒DNA/RNA G-四链体的结合机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非典型TF-DNA。
abstract: hnRNPA1, a protein from the heterogeneous-nuclear ribonucleoprotein family, mediates cellular processes such as RNA metabolism and DNA telomere maintenance. Besides the folded RNA recognition motifs, hnRNPA1 has a  approximately 135 amino-acids long low-complexity domain (LCD) consisting of an RGG-rich region and a prion-like domain (PrLD). Biochemical data suggest that the RGG-rich region modulates the recognition of G-quadruplexes (GQs) in the telomeric repeats. Here, we utilize an in-house developed replica exchange technique (REHT) to generate the heterogeneous conformational ensemble of hnRNPA1-RGG and explore its functional significance in telomere maintenance. Single chain statistics and abundance of structural motifs, as well as consistency with experimentally reported structural data suggest faithful recapitulation of local interactions. We also introduce a protocol to generate functionally significant IDP-nucleic acid complex structures that corroborate well with the experimental knowledge of their binding. We find that RGG-box preferentially binds to the grooves and loops of GQs providing specificity towards certain GQ structures with its sequence and secondary structures. Turn-like structures expose Phe and promote stacking with the G-tetrads, while Tyr and Asn residues form essential hydrogen bonds and electrostatic interactions. Several of these residues were also identified as important by the earlier reported HSQC chemical shift data. Our binding and simulation studies also reveal that a minor population of the RGG-box can perturb telomeric GQs structure, which likely expedites the unfolding activities of hnRNPA1-UP1 at the telomeric end.
abstract_zh: hnRNPA1，一种来自异质核核糖核蛋白家族的蛋白质，介导RNA代谢和DNA端粒维持等细胞过程。除了折叠的RNA识别基序外，hnRNPA1还具有一个约135个氨基酸长的低复杂度结构域（LCD），由富含RGG的区域和朊病毒样结构域（PrLD）组成。生化数据表明，富含RGG的区域调节端粒重复序列中G-四链体（GQs）的识别。在此，我们利用内部开发的副本交换技术（REHT）生成hnRNPA1-RGG的异质构象集合，并探讨其在端粒维持中的功能意义。单链统计和结构基序的丰度，以及与实验报道的结构数据的一致性，表明局部相互作用的忠实再现。我们还引入了一种协议，用于生成与实验结合知识良好吻合的功能性重要IDP-核酸复合物结构。我们发现RGG盒优先结合GQs的沟和环，通过其序列和二级结构对特定GQ结构提供特异性。转角样结构暴露Phe并促进与G-四联体的堆叠，而Tyr和Asn残基形成必需的氢键和静电相互作用。其中几个残基也被早期报道的HSQC化学位移数据识别为重要。我们的结合和模拟研究还揭示，RGG盒的少数群体可以扰动端粒GQs结构，这可能加速hnRNPA1-UP1在端粒末端的解折叠活性。
